name: Grand Prix 5000 S TR

origin.basis: Continental's bicycle tires are marketed from its German site; Germany-made lines are marked 'Handmade in Germany'.

positioning: Continental's tubeless race and all-round road tire, positioned as a balance of speed, grip and puncture protection.
hookless_note: Continental lists separate hookless maximum pressures (73 psi up to 28 mm, 65 psi at 30-32 mm, 58 psi at 35 mm) and permitted rim ranges per size.
weight_basis: Continental black-sidewall claims per size; transparent sidewalls add up to 5 g.
pressure_note: Maximum pressures are for hooked rims; hookless limits are lower.

availability.note: Continental's official Tmall store sells it in mainland China; Continental's German and US catalogs list it for retailers.

caveats: Use the lower hookless pressure on hookless rims and stay inside the permitted rim range for the size.
Fast, light race casing: tread puncture protection measured lower than all-season and training tires.
Check frame and rim clearance for the measured width; tires usually measure wider on wide rims.
